svg.title: Debt snowball versus avalanche illustration
svg.desc: A snowball rolling down a slope and growing larger, representing the snowball and avalanche methods of paying off debts in sequence.
svg.metadata: Original illustration created for MoneyMinded (moneymindedguide.com). Source: in-house vector artwork, not derived from any third-party image. License: MoneyMinded — free for use on this site (own work); no attribution required.
